bece-eng-u1-l1: In 'The children sang loudly in church', what part of speech is 'loudly'?
'Loudly' tells us how they sang, so it describes the verb. That makes it an adverb.
Does it describe a person or an action?
In 'Chika bought a beautiful dress', what part of speech is 'beautiful'?
'Beautiful' describes the noun 'dress', so it is an adjective.
In 'The goat ran into the bush', what part of speech is 'into'?
'Into' shows the relationship between 'ran' and 'the bush'. It is a preposition.
Prepositions often show position or direction.
In 'Emeka and Tunde are friends', what part of speech is 'and'?
'And' joins two names together, so it is a conjunction.
In 'She cooked jollof rice for us', what part of speech is 'She'?
'She' stands in place of a person's name, so it is a pronoun.
In 'Wow! We won the match!', what part of speech is 'Wow'?
'Wow' expresses sudden feeling, so it is an interjection.
In 'The okada rider waited patiently', which word is the verb?
'Waited' is the action word, so it is the verb.
In 'Lagos is a busy city', what part of speech is 'Lagos'?
Lagos is the name of a particular place, so it is a proper noun with a capital letter.
Is it the name of a particular place?
In 'He speaks English very well', what part of speech is 'very'?
'Very' tells us more about 'well', another adverb. Words that modify adverbs are adverbs.
bece-eng-u1-l2: Choose the correct word: Neither of the girls ______ ready for the test.
'Neither' is singular, so it takes the singular verb 'is'.
Choose the correct word: The teacher, with her students, ______ going on an excursion.
The subject is 'the teacher' (singular). 'With her students' does not change the verb.
Choose the correct word: My brothers ______ football every evening.
'Brothers' is plural, so the verb is 'play'.
Is the subject singular or plural?
Choose the correct word: Everybody ______ to be at the assembly by 7:30.
Choose the correct word: The news ______ very good this morning.
'News' looks plural but is singular, so it takes 'is'.
Can you say 'one news' or 'many newses'?
Choose the correct word: The girls in my class ______ very good at netball.
The subject is 'the girls' (plural), so the verb is 'are'. 'In my class' does not change it.
Who is the subject: the girls or the class?
Choose the correct word: Each of the students ______ a textbook.
'Each' is singular, so the verb is 'has'.
Choose the correct word: The scissors ______ on the table.
'Scissors' is always plural, so it takes 'are'.
Choose the correct word: One of my friends ______ from Kano.
The subject is 'one', which is singular, so the verb is 'comes'.
bece-eng-u1-l3: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'ancient'.
'Ancient' means very old. Its opposite is 'modern'.
What is the opposite of very old?
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'brave'.
'Brave' means not afraid. 'Cowardly' means easily afraid.
Someone who runs from danger is...
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'expand'.
'Expand' means to get bigger; 'contract' means to get smaller.
What is the opposite of getting bigger?
Choose the word NEAREST in meaning to 'huge'.
Find the word with the same meaning.
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'humble'.
A humble person does not boast. The opposite is 'proud'.
Choose the word NEAREST in meaning to 'begin'.
Find the word that means the same.
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'scarce'.
Scarce means there is not enough. Plentiful means there is a lot.
Fuel queues happen when fuel is scarce. When there is a lot of fuel, it is...
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'accept'.
To accept is to take; to reject is to refuse.
What do you do when you refuse an offer?
Choose the word NEAREST in meaning to 'rapid'.
bece-eng-u1-l4: Choose the correct option: By the time we got to the stadium, the match ______.
Two past actions: the earlier one uses the past perfect, 'had started'.
Choose the correct option: Bisi ______ her homework before her mother came back.
The homework was done before another past event, so we use 'had finished'.
Use 'had' for the earlier of two past actions.
Choose the correct option: I ______ in this school since 2023.
'Since' with an action that continues to now takes the present perfect, 'have been'.
Choose the correct option: Look! The bus ______ now.
'Look!' and 'now' show the action is happening at this moment, so use the present continuous.
Choose the correct option: Yesterday, Musa ______ his bicycle to school.
What is the past tense of 'ride'?
Choose the correct option: Tomorrow, we ______ our grandmother in the village.
'Tomorrow' shows the future, so use 'will visit'.
Choose the correct option: She ______ already eaten when I arrived.
'Had eaten' shows the meal was over before I arrived.
Two past actions: which came first?
Choose the correct option: Every morning, Ada ______ water from the well.
'Every morning' shows a habit, so use the simple present: 'fetches'.
Choose the correct option: The thief ran away after he ______ the phone.
Stealing came before running away, so we use 'had stolen'.
Which happened first, stealing or running?
bece-eng-u1-l5: Which sentence has the right punctuation?
Where are you going, Ngozi?
Where are you going Ngozi.
where are you going, Ngozi?
Where are you going, Ngozi!
It starts with a capital letter, uses a comma before the name, and ends with a question mark.
It is a question. How should it end?
Pick the sentence that is punctuated correctly.
We bought yam, rice, beans and oil.
We bought yam rice beans and oil.
We bought, yam, rice, beans, and, oil.
we bought yam, rice, beans and oil.
Commas separate items in a list, and the sentence starts with a capital letter.
Use commas between items in a list.
Which word is correctly written with an apostrophe?
The boy's bag
The boys bag's
The boy,s bag
The boy's's bag
The apostrophe before 's' shows that the bag belongs to one boy.
Apostrophes show who owns something.
Which sentence uses capital letters correctly?
My uncle lives in Abuja.
my uncle lives in abuja.
My Uncle Lives In Abuja.
my Uncle lives in Abuja.
A sentence starts with a capital, and proper nouns like Abuja need capitals.
Which words must always start with capitals?
Which of these sentences would get full marks for punctuation?
"Come here," said the teacher.
"Come here" said the teacher.
Come here, said the teacher.
"Come here," Said the teacher.
Speech marks go around the spoken words, with a comma before the closing speech mark.
What did the teacher actually say?
Which is the correct short form of 'do not'?
don't
dont
do'nt
don,t
The apostrophe replaces the missing 'o': don't.
Where is the missing letter?
Which sentence ends with the correct punctuation mark?
What a wonderful day it is!
What a wonderful day it is?
What a wonderful day it is,
what a wonderful day it is.
An exclamation shows strong feeling, so it ends with '!'.
Is this a question or a strong feeling?
Which shows the correct possessive form for more than one girl?
The girls' hostel
The girl's' hostel
The girls hostel's
The girls's hostel
For a plural noun ending in 's', the apostrophe comes after the 's'.
Many girls own one hostel.
Only one of these sentences is punctuated correctly. Which one?
Tunde, my best friend, is from Ibadan.
Tunde my best friend, is from Ibadan.
Tunde, my best friend is from Ibadan.
Tunde my best friend is, from Ibadan.
The extra information 'my best friend' needs a comma on both sides.
Extra information is boxed in by commas.
bece-sci-u1-l1: Water left in a pot on the fire slowly turns into vapour. What is this change called?
Liquid changing into gas is evaporation.
Water vapour forms droplets on the outside of a cold bottle of water. What is this change called?
Gas cooling into liquid is condensation.
Shea butter left in the sun becomes liquid. What is this change called?
Solid turning into liquid when heated is melting.
Water put in a freezer becomes ice. What is this change called?
Liquid turning into solid is freezing.
Camphor (naphthalene) balls in a wardrobe slowly disappear without melting. What is this called?
A solid turning directly into gas is sublimation.
Which of these is a CHEMICAL change?
Burning makes new substances (ash, smoke) and cannot easily be reversed, so it is a chemical change.
Which of these is a PHYSICAL change?
Melted wax can set again; no new substance forms.
At what temperature does pure water boil at sea level?
Pure water boils at 100°C at sea level.
Water freezes at 0°C. It boils at...
Wet clothes on a line dry faster on a sunny, windy day. Why?
Heat and wind speed up evaporation
Heat gives water energy to evaporate, and wind carries the vapour away.
bece-sci-u1-l2: What form of energy does a moving danfo bus have?
What energy change happens in a torchlight when it is switched on?
Chemical energy to electrical energy to light energy
The battery's chemical energy becomes electrical energy, and the bulb turns it into light (and some heat).
What energy does a stone on top of a hill have because of its position?
Stored energy due to height is gravitational potential energy.
It could fall. What kind of stored energy is that?
Food gives our bodies energy. In what form is energy stored in food?
Food stores chemical energy, which the body releases.
Like a battery, food stores energy in chemicals.
Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity.
What does a solar panel take in, and what does it give out?
What energy change happens in an electric fan?
The motor turns electricity into motion.
The law of conservation of energy states that energy:
Cannot be created or destroyed, only changed from one form to another
Energy changes form, but the total amount stays the same.
Energy changes form. Does it disappear?
What energy change happens when you strike a talking drum?
The moving stick's kinetic energy makes the drum vibrate and produce sound.
A generator burns petrol to produce electricity. What energy change takes place?
The chemical energy in petrol is converted (through motion) into electrical energy.
What is stored in the petrol?
bece-sci-u1-l3: Which part of the blood carries oxygen around the body?
Red blood cells contain haemoglobin, which carries oxygen.
They give blood its red colour.
Which part of the blood helps it to clot when you cut yourself?
Platelets help form clots to stop bleeding.
The liquid part of the blood is called:
Plasma is the yellowish liquid that carries cells, food and waste.
Which organ pumps blood around the body?
The heart is a muscle that pumps blood through the blood vessels.
Blood vessels that carry blood AWAY from the heart are called:
Arteries carry blood away from the heart.
A for Arteries, A for Away.
Blood vessels that carry blood BACK to the heart are called:
Veins return blood to the heart.
A shortage of red blood cells or haemoglobin, which makes a person weak and tired, is called:
Anaemia is a lack of red blood cells or haemoglobin.
Iron-rich foods like ugu help prevent it.
Which mineral in food helps the body make haemoglobin?
Iron is needed to make haemoglobin.
Found in beans, liver and green leafy vegetables.
Which tiny blood vessels connect arteries to veins?
Capillaries are very thin vessels where exchange with body cells happens.
They are the smallest blood vessels.
bece-sci-u1-l4: A pair of scissors has the pivot between the effort and the load. What class of lever is it?
In a first-class lever the fulcrum is in the middle.
When you use a pair of tongs to pick up meat, the effort is between the pivot and the load. What class of lever is this?
In a third-class lever the effort is between the fulcrum and the load.
A bottle opener has the load between the pivot and the effort. What class of lever is it?
It is a wheel and axle
Load in the middle means a second-class lever.
A see-saw in the school playground is which class of lever?
The pivot is in the middle, between the two children.
Which of these is a third-class lever?
A broom being used to sweep
When sweeping, your effort hand is between the top (pivot) and the brush (load).
Look for the effort in the middle.
What is the fixed point that a lever turns around called?
A lever turns around its fulcrum.
It is also called the pivot.
Why does a long-handled spanner make it easier to loosen a tight nut?
A longer handle gives a bigger turning effect for the same effort
It reduces the weight of the nut
Moment = force * distance, so a longer handle increases the turning effect.
Moments depend on distance from the pivot.
A crowbar used to lift a heavy stone is which class of lever?
The pivot (a small stone underneath) is between your effort and the heavy load.
Where is the small stone the bar rests on?
Which simple machine is a ramp used to push a heavy drum onto a lorry?
A ramp is an inclined plane: a sloping surface that reduces the effort needed.
bece-sci-u1-l5: Ada pushes a box with a force of 20 N for 5 m. How much work does she do?
A boy lifts a 30 N bag onto a table 2 m high. How much work does he do?
What is the unit of work?
A man pushes against a wall with 200 N, but the wall does not move. How much work does he do on the wall?
No movement means no distance, so no work is done on the wall.
Emeka does 120 J of work pushing a cart 6 m. What force did he use?
A girl uses a force of 40 N to do 200 J of work. How far did she move the load?
How fast is the work done?
A labourer does 300 J of work in 10 s. What is his power?
Which needs more work: lifting a 10 N bag 2 m, or lifting a 5 N bag 3 m?
The 10 N bag (20 J compared with 15 J)
10 * 2 = 20 J; 5 * 3 = 15 J. The 10 N bag needs more.
bece-bus-u1-l1: Which office machine is used to send copies of documents over a telephone line?
A fax machine transmits documents through a phone line.
Which machine is used to destroy confidential documents?
A shredder cuts papers into tiny strips so they cannot be read.
Which machine is used to work out sums quickly and accurately?
Which device is used to make holes in paper for filing?
A perforator punches holes so papers can go into a file.
Which machine prints postage marks on letters instead of using stamps?
A franking machine prints the postage directly on envelopes.
Which machine cuts large stacks of paper neatly?
A guillotine cuts many sheets of paper at once.
Which one has a big blade?
Which device changes a printed document into a digital copy on a computer?
A scanner turns paper documents into digital images.
It 'reads' the paper into the computer.
Which machine joins sheets of paper together with metal pins?
A stapler fastens sheets with staples.
Why should office machines be maintained regularly?
To keep them working well and make them last longer
Regular maintenance prevents breakdowns and extends their life.
What happens to machines that are never serviced?
bece-bus-u1-l2: Buying goods from Ghana and selling them in Nigeria is an example of:
Bringing goods INTO Nigeria from another country is importing.
Are the goods coming in or going out?
Selling Nigerian cocoa to buyers in Britain is an example of:
Selling goods OUT of the country is exporting.
Which direction are the goods going?
Buying goods from one country and re-exporting them to another country is called:
Entrepot trade means importing goods and then re-exporting them.
The goods pass through on their way elsewhere.
A woman sells provisions in small quantities to people in her street. She is a:
Retailers sell in small quantities to final consumers.
Who sells to the final user?
A trader who buys in bulk from manufacturers and sells to retailers is a:
Who buys in very large amounts?
Exchanging goods for goods without using money is called:
Barter is the direct exchange of goods.
Trading yams for fish, with no money.
Trade between Kano and Lagos is called:
Trade within the same country is home trade.
A person who carries goods around on the head to sell is called a:
A hawker moves from place to place selling goods.
Think of someone selling pure water in traffic.
Which of these is a function of the wholesaler?
Wholesalers buy in large quantities and break them into smaller lots for retailers.
What does a wholesaler do with large quantities?
bece-bus-u1-l3: A trader sells a phone and refuses to tell the buyer it is fairly used. Which consumer right is violated?
Consumers have a right to accurate information about what they buy.
What did the buyer not get?
A shop forces customers to buy only one brand of rice. Which consumer right is violated?
Consumers have the right to choose from a variety of goods.
Can the customer pick what they want?
A customer whose new fan stops working on the first day is entitled to a repair or refund. This is the right to:
The right to redress means a consumer can get compensation for faulty goods.
What do you deserve when goods are faulty?
Which Nigerian agency protects consumers against unfair business practices?
Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC)
The FCCPC protects consumers' rights in Nigeria.
Which agency checks that food and drugs sold in Nigeria are safe?
NAFDAC regulates food, drugs and cosmetics.
Look for the NAFDAC number on packages.
Which agency sets quality standards for products in Nigeria?
SON sets and enforces product standards.
A person who buys goods for personal use is called a:
A consumer uses goods and services.
Who uses the goods at the end?
Before buying canned food, a wise consumer should check the:
Checking the expiry date protects the consumer's health.
What tells you if food is still safe?
Which consumer right was violated when Mama Bisi's family fell sick from expired food?
The right to safety protects consumers from harmful goods.
bece-bus-u1-l4: In a cash book, money PAID OUT by the business is recorded on the:
Payments are recorded on the credit (right-hand) side.
Receipts are on the debit side. Payments go on the other side.
The left-hand side of an account is called the:
The debit side is on the left.
A shop receives ₦2,000 from a customer. On which side of the cash book is it recorded?
Money received is a debit in the cash book.
Money in goes on the left.
A shop pays ₦1,500 for transport. On which side of the cash book is it recorded?
Money paid out is a credit in the cash book.
Money out goes on the right.
The cash book records all cash receipts and payments.
The difference between the two sides of the cash book is called the:
The balance is the difference between total receipts and total payments.
If the debit side of a cash book is bigger than the credit side, it means:
More received than paid means cash is left over.
More came in than went out.
A document given to a customer to show that payment has been received is a:
A receipt is proof of payment.
What do you collect after paying?
A document sent to a buyer showing goods supplied and the amount owed is an:
An invoice is a bill for goods supplied on credit.
bece-bus-u1-l5: A shop starts with ₦3,000 cash, receives ₦4,000 and pays out ₦2,500. What is the cash balance?
Opening + received - paid.
A trader starts with ₦10,000, receives ₦6,000 from sales and pays ₦7,000 for goods. What is her cash balance?
Add receipts, subtract payments.
Cash at start ₦2,000; sales ₦5,000; rent paid ₦1,000; wages paid ₦1,500. What is the closing cash?
Subtract both payments.
Total receipts are ₦12,000 and total payments are ₦8,000, with no opening cash. What is the balance?
Receipts minus payments.
A shop starts with ₦1,000. It receives ₦3,000 and pays ₦3,500. What is the cash balance?
Work it out step by step.
A trader's cash balance at the end of Monday is ₦6,000. On Tuesday this is the:
Opening balance
Closing balance
Total payments
Profit
Monday's closing balance becomes Tuesday's opening balance (balance b/d).
What do you start Tuesday with?
Cash at start ₦5,000; received from debtors ₦2,000; cash sales ₦3,000; payments ₦4,000. What is the closing cash?
Add all money in first.
Chidi started with ₦4,000, sold goods for ₦6,000, and bought new stock for ₦5,000. How much cash does he have?
Opening + sales - purchases.
A trader ends the day with ₦7,000 after receiving ₦5,000 and paying ₦3,000. How much did she start with?
Work backwards.
ncee-mat-u1-l1: What is the value of the digit 3 in 3,456?
The 3 is in the thousands place, so its value is 3,000.
Count the places: ones, tens, hundreds, thousands.
What is the value of the digit 5 in 25,814?
The 5 is in the thousands place: 5,000.
Which place is the 5 in?
What is the value of the digit 6 in 1,627?
The 6 is in the hundreds place: 600.
Count from the right.
Write 'four thousand, two hundred and nine' in figures.
4 thousands, 2 hundreds, 0 tens and 9 ones = 4,209.
There are no tens. What goes in the tens place?
Which number is the largest?
Compare digit by digit from the left: 9,870 is largest.
Compare the thousands, then the hundreds.
Round 3,762 to the nearest hundred.
The tens digit is 6 (5 or more), so round up to 3,800.
Look at the tens digit.
What is the value of the digit 8 in 18,203?
The 8 is in the thousands place: 8,000.
Which column is the 8 in?
Arrange 405, 450, 45 and 504 from smallest to largest.
45 has two digits; then compare 405, 450, 504 by their hundreds and tens.
Which number has the fewest digits?
7 thousands, 3 hundreds, 4 tens, 2 ones = 7,342.
Put each part in its place.
ncee-mat-u1-l2: Tunde has 20 sweets and gives 1/4 of them to his sister. How many sweets does he give away?
To find a quarter, divide by 4.
Mama bought 15 oranges. She used 1/3 of them to make juice. How many oranges did she use?
Which fraction is the same as 1/2?
Divide the top and bottom of each fraction by the same number.
Ada ate 2/8 of a cake. What fraction is that in its simplest form?
When the bottom numbers are the same, add the top numbers: 1 + 2 = 3, giving 3/4.
The bottom number stays the same.
There are 24 pupils in a class and 2/3 of them are girls. How many girls are there?
ncee-mat-u1-l3: A pair of shoes costs ₦4,000. There is a 10% discount. How much is the discount?
A shirt costs ₦3,000. It is sold at a 20% discount. What is the new price?
Find the discount, then subtract it.
A bag of rice costs ₦10,000 and the price goes up by 10%. What is the new price?
Bola scored 18 out of 20 in a test. What is her score as a percentage?
A trader buys a radio for ₦5,000 and sells it for ₦6,000. What is his profit?
A book costs ₦1,200 and a 25% discount is given. How much do you pay?
A quarter of 1,200 is the discount.
ncee-mat-u1-l4: What is the LCM of 3 and 4?
Multiples of 3: 3, 6, 9, 12. Multiples of 4: 4, 8, 12. The lowest common one is 12.
List the multiples of each number.
What is the LCM of 2 and 5?
The first number in both lists of multiples is 10.
Count in 2s and in 5s.
What is the HCF of 12 and 18?
Factors of 12: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12. Factors of 18: 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 18. The highest common factor is 6.
List the factors of each number.
What is the LCM of 6 and 8?
Multiples of 8: 8, 16, 24. 24 is also a multiple of 6.
Check the multiples of the bigger number.
What is the HCF of 10 and 15?
5 is the largest number that divides both 10 and 15.
What is the biggest number that divides both?
Which of these is a prime number?
7 has only two factors, 1 and itself.
A prime number has exactly two factors.
What are the factors of 8?
These numbers divide 8 exactly.
Which numbers divide 8 with no remainder?
One bell rings every 4 minutes and another every 6 minutes. They ring together now. After how many minutes will they next ring together?
12 minutes
10 minutes
24 minutes
2 minutes
The LCM of 4 and 6 is 12.
This is an LCM problem.
What is the LCM of 5 and 10?
10 is a multiple of both 5 and 10.
Is 10 already a multiple of 5?
ncee-mat-u1-l5: A rectangle is 6 m long and 4 m wide. What is its area?
A square has sides of 5 cm. What is its area?
All sides of a square are equal.
A rectangle is 7 m long and 3 m wide. What is its perimeter?
Perimeter is the distance all the way round.
A square farm has sides of 9 m. What is its perimeter?
A classroom floor is 8 m by 6 m. What is its area?
A rectangle has an area of 30 m² and a length of 6 m. What is its width?
What is the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 4 cm?
Area of a triangle = 1/2 * base * height = 1/2 * 10 * 4 = 20 cm².
A triangle is half of a rectangle.
A football field is 100 m long and 50 m wide. What is its perimeter?
Add length and width, then double.
Which unit is used to measure area?
Area is measured in square units such as m² or cm².
ncee-eng-u1-l1: Words ending in x, s, sh or ch add 'es'.
Change the 'y' to 'i' and add 'es': babies.
A consonant before 'y' means change y to i.
Many words ending in 'fe' change to 'ves': knives.
'Sheep' stays the same in the plural.
Some words don't change at all.
'Mango' takes 'es' in the plural: mangoes ('mangos' is also seen, but 'mangoes' is the usual form).
ncee-eng-u1-l2: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'hot'.
The opposite of hot is cold.
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'tall'.
The opposite of tall is short.
A person who is not tall is...
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'happy'.
The opposite of happy is sad.
How do you feel when you lose something?
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'open'.
The opposite of open is close (or shut).
What do you do to a door at night?
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'rich'.
The opposite of rich is poor.
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'early'.
The opposite of early is late.
If you are not early for school, you are...
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'strong'.
The opposite of strong is weak.
Choose the word NEAREST in meaning to 'little'.
Little and small mean the same.
Find the word that means the same.
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to 'clean'.
The opposite of clean is dirty.
What are your clothes after playing in mud?
ncee-eng-u1-l3: Fill in the gap: Last Sunday, we ______ to church.
'Last Sunday' is in the past, so we use 'went'.
What is the past tense of 'go'?
Fill in the gap: Yesterday, Ada ______ a letter to her uncle.
Fill in the gap: Every day, my father ______ to work.
'Every day' shows a habit, so use 'goes'.
Fill in the gap: I ______ my lunch an hour ago.
'An hour ago' is past, so use 'ate'.
Fill in the gap: Tomorrow, we ______ visit the zoo.
'Tomorrow' is in the future, so use 'will'.
Fill in the gap: Look! The baby ______ now.
'Now' shows an action happening at the moment.
Fill in the gap: Last year, Musa ______ the race.
Fill in the gap: The children ______ football in the field yesterday.
Fill in the gap: She ______ her teeth every morning.
'Every morning' is a habit, and 'she' takes 'brushes'.
ncee-eng-u1-l4: Which word below is spelt without any mistake?
Pick the word with the right spelling.
Only one of these words has no spelling mistake. Which one?
'Tomorrow' has one m and two r's.
Your teacher wrote four spellings on the board. Which one is right?
'Different' has two f's and ends in -ent.
Which of these would you write in your exercise book?
'Necessary' has one c and two s's.
One collar, two sleeves: 1 c, 2 s.
Choose the word that is spelt the right way.
ncee-eng-u1-l5: Find the sentence with correct punctuation marks.
I like rice, beans and plantain.
I like rice beans and plantain.
i like rice, beans and plantain.
I like, rice, beans and plantain.
Commas separate the items in the list, and the sentence starts with a capital letter.
Which sentence uses commas, capitals and full stops correctly?
It is a question, so it ends with a question mark.
Pick the sentence where capital letters are used the right way.
Names of people and places start with capital letters.
The apostrophe shows the dog belongs to Tunde.
Which sentence ends with the right punctuation mark?
Help! The house is on fire!
Help? The house is on fire?
Help, the house is on fire,
help the house is on fire.
Strong feelings and warnings end with an exclamation mark.
Which is the correct short form of 'I am'?
The apostrophe replaces the missing 'a': I'm.
Spot the sentence with no punctuation mistakes.
My mother said, Come home early.
Speech marks go around the spoken words, and the spoken words start with a capital.
Which day of the week is written correctly?
Days of the week always start with a capital letter.
Which of these is written correctly?
We will travel to Kano on Friday.
